design_primary.name: primary
design_primary.note: PWT time-series IRF (paper Fig. III) with bootstrap uncertainty; NOAA h=2 p=2 shocks, filter fitted on the paper's window (data 1950-2022); innovation composition; all shocks with post-2025 effects plus simulated post-2027 shocks; no-effect path = IMF WEO projection (October 2026) in WDI units with the IMF's historical forecast errors (average miss kept); in the paper's world the background is net of the part of those misses the paper's estimates attribute to temperature shocks; statistic = per-capita growth from 2026 to the end year minus IMF baseline growth over the same years.

vintages.imf_baseline: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (DataMapper, retrieved 17 Oct 2026)
vintages.imf_errors: IMF WEO historical forecasts: world real GDP growth, October vintages 1990-2020 (31 forecasts), realized = October 2026 WEO estimates

end_year.rule: highest Youden J to two decimals, ties to the earlier year; frozen at listing

provisional.enso_model: s_y = +0.020 +0.073*RONI_DJF(y) +0.015*RONI_DJF(y-1) -0.038*RONI_DJF(y-2); resid sd 0.088 C, R2 0.53, n=63 (volcanic years excluded)
provisional.note: Placeholders until NOAA publishes the annual values (2026: mid-Jan 2027; 2027: mid-Jan 2028). Terms lock only after the 2027 value is final.

frozen_drift_reference.note: the no-effect path until 30 Oct 2026; now a sensitivity variant

baseline_primary.vintage: IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (DataMapper, retrieved 17 Oct 2026)

errors.source: IMF WEO historical forecasts: world real GDP growth, October vintages 1990-2020 (31 forecasts), realized = October 2026 WEO estimates
errors.average_miss: kept (decided 30 Oct 2026): the no-effect path carries the IMF's historical average miss
errors.beyond_max_lead: each later year drawn independently from the last lead's errors

p_no_at_primary_c_by_scope.note: P(M <= primary c) when the outcome is generated by each scope's B&K effect

future_temperatures.model: winter RONI after a strong El Niño: replay of 7 analogs [1958, 1966, 1973, 1983, 1992, 1998, 2016]; otherwise AR(2) R_y = +0.088 -0.037 R_(y-1) -0.226 R_(y-2); shock = ENSO regression + resampled residual (sd 0.108 C, n=73, volcanic years included)
future_temperatures.note: simulated post-2027 shocks enter H1 through their innovations (the part the two prior shocks do not predict); the cutoff is still fixed in advance

conditional_contracts.levels_note: 20th/50th/80th percentiles of the current 2027 forecast; bins split halfway between them

point_predictions.note: growth 2026-2031, point IRF, central 2026-27 temperatures, no post-2027 shocks

contract_variants.variant: IRF: BU time series (NOAA p=6 shocks)
IRF: PWT panel, GDP-weighted (paper App. Fig. B.10)
paper's world: raw IMF misses (no netting)
IRF: re-estimated with NOAA temperature (paper App. B.11)
IRF: re-estimated on WDI world GDP (paper App. B.11)
